scope: Executable-implementation checklist for future native USPTO15K admission. No decoding, extraction, dataset parsing, scientific arrays, author/model execution, training or scoring is authorized.

effective_contract.precedence: immutable v1 plus corrected v3; inaccurate v2 excluded

raw_archive.verification_basis: Existing sealed acquisition receipt and file size stat only. Archive bytes were not opened or rehashed in this authoring task.

native_source.licence: No declared code licence established in pinned tree. Preserve provenance. This protocol does not grant distribution rights.

split_binding.unit: released archive reaction-line membership; never resplit atoms,molecules,reactions or rows
split_binding.exact_paths_status: Author runner proves logical filenames, not ZIP prefixes or complete archive topology. No archive was opened.
split_binding.cross_split_overlap_policy: Report exact-line/canonical-reaction overlap diagnostics after protocol freeze without deleting or reassigning archive-native members. Corrected overlap conditions must be separate.

future_extraction_policy.member_hash_algorithm: SHA256 over full exact uncompressed member bytes, with CRC32 verification
reject: absolute paths,drive-qualified paths or UNC roots
backslashes or empty,dot or dotdot components in file paths
symlink,hardlink,device,FIFO or unsupported special member type
duplicate normalized or case-folded paths and conflicting file/directory paths
resolved path escape or existing/symlink destination components
member/total streamed bytes beyond frozen caps or declared ZIP length mismatch
future_extraction_policy.directories: Record genuine directory entries without trailing-slash empty-component rejection. No permissions from archive are trusted.
future_extraction_policy.exceed_bounds: Stop and preserve failure. Reassess budget/limits in a new reviewed contract, never drop members to fit the cap.
future_extraction_policy.source_layout_mapping: If the archive has a prefix, bind the exact three paths explicitly. Relocation/copy is mechanical only after byte/hash/row equivalence; no flattening by guessed basename.

native_parser.native_text_open: open(path,"r"), default runtime text encoding and universal newline handling; bind actual locale/encoding before parsing. Preserve original member bytes and record byte-to-text row mapping.
native_parser.rxn_id: 0-based enumerate index in its original split file including dropped rows, not compact retained index
native_parser.line_handling: strip then split whitespace; uses first two fields only; reactant side is rxn_smi.split(">>")[0]; no new requirement for product/delimiter validation
native_parser.edit_labels: Union of lost/gained-H atom-map integers and endpoints of parsed deleted/added bonds. Products and held-out labels are not model inputs.
native_parser.reactants: Input order from dot-separated nonempty reactant substrings; RDKit atom order and native feature/edge order retained
native_whole_row_drop_reasons: empty edit atom set including edit field with other than four semicolon parts
any unparseable or zero-atom nonempty reactant
no reactant atom matching any positive edit map
native_parser.native_partial_token_omissions: Malformed bond tokens with other than3 dash-separated parts or ValueError are ignored even when the row remains retained. Record omitted tokens; do not turn them into row drops.
native_parser.native_fatal_exception: _parse_atom_list calls int without catching ValueError; preserve this or other native exception as fatal, with raw row ID/exception receipt. Never silently catch-and-drop.
native_parser.malformed_accepted_semantics: Native permits extra whitespace fields,does not require product parsing,and does not reject duplicate atom maps. Record anomalies without changing admission.

max_examples_semantics.rule: For each raw row increment n_seen, call native _parse_line(i,line); if returned example append it and increment n_kept; break after append when max_examples is notNone and n_kept>=max_examples.
max_examples_semantics.zero_or_negative_limit: Source would still append one accepted example before stopping; not used or normalized by this protocol.

identity_fields: raw byte offset,length and exact-row SHA256
native branch reason or fatal exception
atom-map IDs and external edit-label identity
row_accounting.counts: Sum disjoint statuses over all original raw rows; report raw/seen/retained/dropped/fatal/unreached/tail rows and retained atoms per split. Only the full condition can claim full native-parser row coverage.
row_accounting.failures: Retain failures and unsupported/nonfinite predictions. Do not report fewer observations as a completed full-data paired endpoint.
row_accounting.native_denominator: Pooled atoms of all native-retained TEST reactions; additionally report raw-reaction retention, partial-token omissions and all method prediction coverage. Dropped reactions have no invented atom labels or AP.
row_accounting.instrumentation_category: mechanical only after native-output/exception/order parity; changing drop rules,token handling,features,atom labels or positive support is a separate derived endpoint

conditions.coverage: First1000 native-retained TRAIN reactions in original order, full native-retained VALID/TEST
conditions.note: Matches saved author configuration shape. Raw author-used snapshot and entry initialization RNG are unresolved.

difference_from_saved1000.effect: Use all native-retained TRAIN reactions, retaining saved128-hidden,1-layer model recipe. Source parser,VALID/TEST unchanged.

conditions.paper_Table3_binding: Unresolved. Full coverage plus saved architecture is not automatically every paper Table3 cell.

native_training.native_source_model: GraphSetConv from gst.py; gst_v2 alias or substitute prohibited
native_training.local_operator_and_gate: Pinned source GraphSetConv retained; source local+home+sigmoid(g(local,context))*context differs from paper two-gate equation. Paper-equation model is separate scientific implementation.
native_training.native_parameter_equalization: smaller: preserve author exhaustive multiple-of-head width search and all build order/RNG consumption; report actual widths and parameter counts. Saved widths/counts are reference metadata, not this task measurements.
native_training.seed_caveat: run builds model before train_one calls torch.manual_seed,np.random.seed,random.seed. Equalization constructs models first. Preserve native ordering and record process-entry/per-build RNG states. Original initialization state unknown. Moving seed before construction or choosing a new initialization seed is a disclosed scientific change.
native_training.batch_rng: random.Random(seed*7919+1), cumulative epoch shuffles over retained training index list
native_training.positive_class_weight: max(negative_atom_count/max(positive_atom_count,1),1) from firstmin(len(TRAIN),1000) retained TRAIN examples only; no VALID/TEST target fitting
native_training.source_scheduler: CosineAnnealingLR with T_max=epochs*max(1,len(TRAIN)//batch_size), stepped after every optimizer batch including final partial batches. Do not replace floor by ceiling.
native_training.selection: Strictly greater VALID pooled AP wins; tie retains earliest best. If no finite improving VALID AP, source keeps final weights and that fallback must be explicit.
native_training.native_eval: Inference order unchanged,shuffleFalse. Sigmoid logits pooled across all retained atoms. sklearn.average_precision_score; NaN if y_true has fewer than2 classes. No reaction averaging,accuracy substitution,class balancing or probability calibration.
native_training.test_access: run loads and audits TEST before fitting,then train_one evaluates selected state on TEST per model/seed. Preserve/disclose source-native access; freeze all tuning/conditions before it and prohibit adaptive choice from TEST results.

paper_stated_per_model_learning_rate.paper_anchor: Section3.1.2, effective v3 GST learning_rates amendment
paper_stated_per_model_learning_rate.implementation: Unimplemented. Single source --lr is shared, so do not claim per-model rates from unchanged all-model invocation. Bind any new driver/diff and validation separately.
paper_stated_per_model_learning_rate.paper_remaining_settings: Complete Table3 per-cell architecture,initialization,normalization,scheduler and raw identity still need qualification. Paper optimizer agrees with USPTO source AdamW. BH Adam versus paper AdamW discrepancy remains in effective contract and is outside this USPTO protocol.

paired_support.candidate_adapter: Unimplemented and scientifically declared: native19-feature molecular graphs,set construction,per-atom head,BCE/selection and every candidate architecture/training choice must be frozen.
paired_support.scope_of_claim: Same-data native-task paired endpoint only after full complete execution. This artifact reports no numerical/native reproduction or superiority result.

runtime_identity.port_policy: Using Python3.12/Torch2.10+cu129 or other replacement requires a named runtime port,exact closure and qualification. No environment is chosen,installed or authorized here.

checks: Root records the unfinished H022 native-data branch/repeat reason before execution.
Preserve immutable v1+v3 and PASS receipt. Independent review of this new protocol and later implementation is still required.
Root freezes a new active execution contract with exact source copy/runtime/output pins, ledger reservation and projected peak below450GB. This inactive artifact is not an execution permission.
Before opening ZIP, verify its full current SHA256, bytes and Git blob hash against the existing acquisition receipt.
Read the central directory under explicit bounds, reject every unsafe member and retain all member metadata including ancillary files. Do not extract any payload at this stage.

Freeze actual archive paths for train.txt,valid.txt,test.txt only after an unambiguous central-directory inventory. Exact paths are currently unknown. Extra split-like members or ambiguous duplicate basenames stop admission.
Freeze method/flags/CRC32/compressed and uncompressed bytes and archive order for every member. Names alone are not member hashes.
Only after S1 approval, stream every admitted regular member to a fresh owned destination without extractall, overwrite, links or path rewriting.
Enforce resolved containment, exclusive no-follow file creation and declared streaming byte limits. Verify CRC and compute SHA256 from exact uncompressed bytes.
Retain a full archive-member manifest. Failures preserve partial files and receipts, which are not accepted as a complete dataset. New attempts use fresh destinations.
Bind source logical split names to exact frozen archive member paths. Any mechanical layout mapping retains original bytes, hashes and ordered content.

Implement transparent observation-only instrumentation around the genuine pinned parser, without changing successful outputs, accepted malformed tokens, atom labels, feature/atom/reactant order or native retained-limit semantics.
Qualify on handmade fixtures before touching dataset rows. Compare native/instrumented retained IDs, all labels/features/edges and exceptional behavior.
Record a byte-level row identity and disjoint status for every raw row. Saved1000 tail rows remain not-parsed-due-to-native-retained-limit rather than declared invalid.
Instrument native partial bond-token omissions separately from whole-row drops. Preserve fatal parser exceptions as failures, never convert them to dropped rows.
Acquire an execution copy at the exact GST commit and verify its complete file inventory. Never modify pristine cached source.
Freeze a coherent task-specific package closure, interpreter, RDKit, PyG, NumPy, sklearn, Torch, native libraries and device. Author saved environment is only partly pinned.
Use genuine gst.py and all four author models. Do not implement or alias gst_v2. Qualify handmade forward/backward/checkpoint/reload and parser numerical parity.
Freeze execution-copy/instrumentation diffs and source/RNG/initialization semantics. Any seed-before-construction, optimizer, gate or scheduling correction is a separately named scientific change.
Freeze saved1000 and full-data coverage as separate conditions, and released common-LR versus paper per-model-LR conditions separately. Original paper Table3 bindings remain unresolved.
Freeze candidate input/head/objective adapter and identical accepted reaction/atom support before scoring. Candidate failures cannot silently shrink comparator coverage.

Seal selections and native data access before a final source-native TEST run. Source runner reads/audits TEST before fitting and reports per-fit TEST scores, so its release protocol exposes TEST summaries and must not support later tuning.

Preserve every selected checkpoint, complete atom-level predictions, labels in an external scoring namespace, per-reaction support/failure status and native pooled AP. Report incomplete coverage as incomplete.
